text: You see Gretch, Doc Morbid's assistant.
source_text: You see Gretch, Doc Morbid's assistant.

text: Don't talk to me like that, cretin.
source_text: Don't talk to me like that, cretin.

text: 你看到一个肥胖的侏儒。
source_text: 你看到一个肥胖的侏儒。

text: 你看到格雷彻，莫彼得医生的助理。
source_text: 你看到格雷彻，莫彼得医生的助理。

text: 不要这样对我说话，白痴。
source_text: 不要这样对我说话，白痴。

text: 我来看一看你们在搞什么。
source_text: 我来看一看你们在搞什么。

text: Okay? Does that mean that you're almost done?
source_text: Okay? Does that mean that you're almost done?

text: You're a little slow, aren't you?
source_text: You're a little slow, aren't you?

text: Body parts almost ready to go to Hub.
source_text: Body parts almost ready to go to Hub.

text: 行吗？那是不是意味着你已经差不多做完了？
source_text: 行吗？那是不是意味着你已经差不多做完了？

text: 身体部分差不多可以送去哈勃城了。
source_text: 身体部分差不多可以送去哈勃城了。

text: Of course. That's why I'm here.
source_text: Of course. That's why I'm here.

text: I don't think I want to hear about this.
source_text: I don't think I want to hear about this.

text: Iguana man Bob send you . . . he happy, lots of good meat . . .
source_text: Iguana man Bob send you . . . he happy, lots of good meat . . .

text: He's selling human body parts for people to eat?
source_text: He's selling human body parts for people to eat?

text: You sick little scab, I'm gonna cut you up and sell you as meat!
source_text: You sick little scab, I'm gonna cut you up and sell you as meat!

text: Of course . . . I'll be back in a minute.
source_text: Of course . . . I'll be back in a minute.

text: For Bob to sell . . . to eat . . . why you ask what we use for?
source_text: For Bob to sell . . . to eat . . . why you ask what we use for?

text: I wasn't sure this was where Bob got his human meat from.
source_text: I wasn't sure this was where Bob got his human meat from.

text: Sometimes I have a little trouble thinking.
source_text: Sometimes I have a little trouble thinking.

text: Me have trouble thinking, too . . . what we talk about?
source_text: Me have trouble thinking, too . . . what we talk about?

text: You were telling me what you're doing.
source_text: You were telling me what you're doing.

text: We were talking about how stupid you are.
source_text: We were talking about how stupid you are.

text: I don't talk to you any more.
source_text: I don't talk to you any more.

text: Yes . . . Doc Morbid has best human bodies around. None better.
source_text: Yes . . . Doc Morbid has best human bodies around. None better.

text: Uh . . . I'll be back to pick up the . . . bodies . . . in a little while. Goodbye.
source_text: Uh . . . I'll be back to pick up the . . . bodies . . . in a little while. Goodbye.

text: I go back to work now.
source_text: I go back to work now.

text: Don't be messing with the Doctor's stuff!
source_text: Don't be messing with the Doctor's stuff!

text: 当然，这就是为什么我在这。
source_text: 当然，这就是为什么我在这。

text: 我认为我没有必要听这些。
source_text: 我认为我没有必要听这些。

text: 蜥蜴商人鲍勃给你……他很高兴，这么多鲜肉……
source_text: 蜥蜴商人鲍勃给你……他很高兴，这么多鲜肉……

text: 他正在卖人的身体给人去吃？
source_text: 他正在卖人的身体给人去吃？

text: 你这个变态的衰人, 我会把你砍碎当肉去卖！
source_text: 你这个变态的衰人, 我会把你砍碎当肉去卖！

text: 由于鲍勃去卖……去吃……你为什么问我们把它用在哪？
source_text: 由于鲍勃去卖……去吃……你为什么问我们把它用在哪？

text: 我不知道鲍勃在哪里找到的这些人肉。
source_text: 我不知道鲍勃在哪里找到的这些人肉。

text: 我也记性不好……说到哪了？
source_text: 我也记性不好……说到哪了？

text: 你刚才在跟我说你在做什么。
source_text: 你刚才在跟我说你在做什么。

text: 我刚才在跟你说你他妈太傻了。

text: 是……莫彼得医生有这附近最好的人尸。是最好的。
source_text: 是……莫彼得医生有这附近最好的人尸。是最好的。

text: 恩……我会回来收拾这些……身体……马上。再见。
